items.headline: Highlight: No. 10 Texas A&M bests Arizona State as defense scores twice in fourth
items.description: The Aggies pull away late in the fourth quarter as Marco Jones' fumble recovery for a 55-yard touchdown and Julio Humphrey's pick-six fuels the 48-20 win over the Sun Devils.

items.headline: Mizzou's jabs at Kansas headline top trolls of college football Week 2
items.description: The Tigers had a number of trolls for their rivals after a Week 2 Border War win.

items.headline: Mike Elko explains how Texas A&M's defense shut down Arizona State
items.description: After recording the most takeaways in a game since 2023, Elko explains how the No. 10 Aggies took over the game to defeat the Sun Devils.

items.headline: No. 10 Texas A&M beats Arizona State 48-20 as defense scores twice in fourth
items.description: — Marcel Reed had three touchdown passes and the defense scored twice in the fourth quarter as No. 10 Texas A&M pulled away late for a 48-20 victory over Arizona State on Saturday.
